full_page.content:
c. 1956
The following is a faithful transcription of a handwritten message by the Servant of God Fr. Solanus Casey, O. F. M. Cap.
Rational Creature: Thy Existence? Thy Destiny!
But 0 too Thy responsability? Answer Ist. Glory to God! I am what I am
God made me to know Him. o! what a blessed aim ! To love Him and serve Him? Sure rests in the same:
It's Heaven begun, --- for the Grateful --- on Earth To treasure aright ! ? ! Highest Heaven its worth.
(This poem is his own composition.)
The following is a faithful transcription of an autograph by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap., written on his picture before the Grotto of our Lady:
Glory be to God! How little is it possible that we be properly, Grateful to Him!
Fr. Solanus
Pray for his further conversion.
